title: Oily Tender Portuguese Cod Stew
description: This indulgent Portuguese dish features tender cod, cured with shio-koji for added depth of flavor, in a rich and resinous stew.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-koji and a pinch of black pepper to create the cure.
Place the cod fillets in a shallow dish and coat evenly with the shio-koji cure.
Let the cod cure in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced carrots and diced potatoes to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the white wine and fish stock to the pot, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Remove the cod from the cure, rinsing off any excess under cold running water.
Add the cod to the pot, covering with a lid and transferring to the preheated oven.
